label: No necessary parts, ordinary contingency, selected fusion and modal part persistence
term: no necessary parts, ordinary contingency, selected fusion and modal part persistence
resolution: NoNecessaryPartsAt omits actual existence, unlike ContingentAt. It does not assert physical whole/cosmos actuality or causal status. Existing Fusion includes upper bounds plus the no-extra-parts overlap clause; a least upper bound or mere type-sum phrase is not silently equivalent. A2’s type-indexed existence need not be unrestricted fusion over every Lean Set or an all-entities whole. B is a candidate carrier, not automatically all actually existing things. Modal downward closure is an explicit input; local part existence and normal modal logic do not replace cross-world scope/persistence. The typed L3 step does not derive source L1/L2, actual fusion existence, an external cause, nonoverlap, necessity of a cause or God. Source CC100 assertions remain bare/unaliased; unread cited Koons editions are not attributed. No numerical distinction/nonparthood/nonoverlap equivalence or metaphysical truth is introduced.
